primaryComponents: High-impact Polymer Chassis (upper and lower shells)
Two independently-driven Rear Drive Wheels with integrated electric motors and gearboxes
One or more Front Caster Wheels (swiveling, unpowered)
Cutting Deck Assembly with integrated electric blade motor
Rotating Blade Disc with multiple pivoting razor blades
Impact/Collision Sensors (e.g., pressure-sensitive bumpers, ultrasonic sensors)
User Interface Panel (keypad, LCD display, physical buttons)
Rubber seals and gaskets for weather protection
operationalLogic: The Automower 450X navigates within a defined boundary, primarily using a perimeter wire signal, supplemented by a guide wire for returning to its charging station, and built-in GPS for systematic mowing patterns. Two independently controlled electric motors drive the rear wheels, enabling differential steering for precise movement and turns. A separate electric motor rotates a cutting disc equipped with free-pivoting razor blades, which retract on impact with hard objects to prevent damage and ensure safety. Safety mechanisms, including lift and tilt sensors, automatically stop the blades if the mower is lifted or tips over. Collision sensors detect obstacles, prompting the mower to change direction. When the battery charge is low, the mower autonomously returns to its charging station, aligning its charging contact plates with those of the station for automatic recharging.
maintenanceNodes: Battery Pack (eventual replacement due to degradation)
Drive Wheels and Tires (wear and tear, tread replacement)
Underside/Cutting Deck (periodic cleaning of grass clippings)
Charging Contacts (require cleaning for optimal connection)
Motors (drive and blade motors, potential service or replacement due to wear)
Seals and Gaskets (can degrade, affecting water resistance)
Sensors (cleaning or replacement if obstructed or damaged)
